title: Edit Hindi PDF
description: Replace detected Hindi or English text, add text overlays, and export a new PDF. Core editing stays on your device.

title: Sign PDF
description: Draw, type or upload your signature and place it by hand, or on every page or chosen pages at the same spot, adjusting any page on its own. Processing stays on your device. Adds an electronic signature image, not a certificate-based digital signature.

title: Fill PDF Form
description: Type into a PDF form's own fields in Hindi or English, tick boxes and choose options, then download the filled copy. Processing stays on your device.

title: Translate Hindi ↔ English
description: Translate Hindi or English text after approving secure AI processing. Review the translated text and export a new PDF.

title: Merge PDF
description: Combine multiple PDFs in your chosen order. Processing stays in your browser and creates a new file.

title: Split PDF
description: Extract selected page ranges into a new PDF. Processing stays on your device.

title: Compress PDF
description: Reduce PDF size by re-encoding pages as images. Review readability before downloading; text becomes image-based.

title: PDF to Word
description: Convert a Hindi or English PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file. Text is read from the PDF or by OCR on your device, ruled tables become Word tables and pictures come along in reading order.

title: Word to PDF
description: Turn a Word (.docx) file with Hindi or English text into a PDF in your browser, as page images or through Save as PDF with selectable text.
